libXt 1.3.1 - X Toolkit Intrinsics (Xt)

Source: https://www.x.org/releases/individual/lib/libXt-1.3.1.tar.xz
Tarball: references/_tarballs/libXt-1.3.1.tar.xz
Extracted to: references/libXt-1.3.1/ (read-only reference copy)
Copied into third-party/: src/, include/, COPYING (unmodified).

License: MIT/X11 (see COPYING).

Build: driven by third-party/libXt/CMakeLists.txt, not the upstream
autotools. Links against emx11 (our Xlib replacement).

Upgrade procedure: replace references/_tarballs/libXt-*.tar.xz with a
newer upstream release, re-extract into references/, diff against
third-party/libXt/ to pick up any patches we have applied locally, then
re-copy src/ and include/.
